articles.summary: Born between the late 90s and early 2010s, the generation referred to as ‘Gen Z’ has grown up fully in the digital age. To help brands looking to attract this consumer base, Sonoco Metal Packaging EMEA partnered with trends agency, Groupe Caramel, to study how packaging influences Gen Z purchasing behavior.
articles.title: 6 Packaging Insights That Competitive Brands Adopt to Attract Gen Z
